t: You're on Marchmont Street, the main high street for southern King's Cross and eastern Bloomsbury. It runs from the Brunswick Centre and Russell Square station in the south up to Tavistock Place, where it becomes Cartwright Gardens. The name comes from Hugh Hume-Campbell, 3rd Earl of Marchmont, a Scottish politician. He sat in the House of Commons from 1734 until 1740, when he became Earl, and from 1750 in the House of Lords as a Scottish representative peer.
